props.title: Named Slots
props.description: A page layout with named areas: header, sidebar, content, and footer. Cards below are generated from a list of items.
props.technicalDescription: The page is assembled from named areas, and each area renders its own content: a header, a three-item sidebar, the main content, and a footer. The cards below come from a list: every item produces a card with its own title and body. The same layout definition places each piece in its spot.

props.text: 📌 Page header — placed via the header slot

Main content — rendered in the content slot, to the right of the sidebar. Note the spec declares header first, but this element still renders in the middle: the component decides where each slot goes.
© Footer — rendered below everything via the footer slot
